evidence.title: Israel is still demolishing towns across Gaza

occurrences.checkable_against: Satellite imagery and population records for Rafah
occurrences.quote_span: The city of Rafah, once home to a quarter million people, has been erased.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Satellite imagery and Israeli military territorial-control records
occurrences.quote_span: Demolition, using bulldozers and explosives, has continued unabated since the Israel-Hamas ceasefire deal reached a year ago, as the military solidifies its hold on just over 60% of the territory that it still controls.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: UN humanitarian shelter and displacement assessments for Gaza
occurrences.quote_span: With almost the entire population homeless, the coastal territory is now effectively one of the world’s most populated tent cities.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Maps of Israeli military control and Gaza population distribution
occurrences.quote_span: Gaza’s population is squeezed into about 40% of the tiny territory, and Israel’s military controls the rest.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: The U.N.-appointed expert's February report on Gaza destruction
occurrences.quote_span: But a U.N.-appointed expert said in a February report that the scale of destruction of civilian housing and infrastructure in Gaza “is unprecedented even by the terrible standards of modern warfare since the 20th century.”
occurrences.speaker: U.N.-appointed expert
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Gaza health authority amputation records
occurrences.quote_span: Shadi Barawi lost his father early in the war. Soon after that, Barawi was hit by shrapnel from a strike near his home in Gaza City, and his leg was amputated — one of some 6,000 amputees left by the war.
occurrences.speaker: Shadi Barawi
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Shadi Barawi's recorded interview and work activity
occurrences.quote_span: “I’m working in tough circumstances,” he said. “I’m on one leg. I might do cuts for three customers, then I get tired and stop and rest, but then I keep going,” he said.
occurrences.speaker: Shadi Barawi
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli strike logs and Gaza casualty records
occurrences.quote_span: While the ceasefire deal stopped the offensives and heaviest bombardment, Israel hits tents, cars and buildings almost daily in strikes that it says target Hamas members — but that regularly kill women, children and other family members.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Gaza population estimates and humanitarian demographic records
occurrences.quote_span: Gaza’s mangled landscape is just one of the wounds on top of wounds that the enclave’s 2 million Palestinians have endured since Israel launched its campaign to destroy Hamas after the militants’ Oct. 7, 2023, attack on southern Israel.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Shadi Barawi's recorded interview and family testimony
occurrences.quote_span: After losing his leg, “I lost all hope in life,” the 35-year-old said. But he was the sole support, he said, for his own family of six and his five sisters.
occurrences.speaker: Shadi Barawi
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: The U.N.-appointed expert's February report and applicable international-law definitions
occurrences.quote_span: The report warned that it could constitute a crime against humanity or reach the level of genocide, which under international law includes “deliberately inflicting conditions of life calculated to bring about physical destruction.”
occurrences.speaker: U.N.-appointed expert
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: UNRWA refugee-camp population records for Jabaliya
occurrences.quote_span: Jabaliya was once home to the Gaza Strip’s biggest refugee camp, home to some 120,000 refugees and tens of thousands of other residents in a densely built urban district.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Satellite imagery and U.N. facility records for Jabaliya
occurrences.quote_span: In Jabaliya in the north, most of the al-Awda Hospital Complex was reduced to rubble in recent months, as were a number of U.N.-run school buildings, satellite images show.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Planet Labs satellite imagery of Gaza
occurrences.quote_span: The Planet Labs imagery shows at least 50 Israeli military outposts built throughout the Israeli-held part of Gaza, at least 18 of them constructed since the ceasefire began.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Population records and satellite imagery for Beit Hanoun
occurrences.quote_span: Similarly, most of Beit Hanoun, once a town of some 70,000 people in Gaza’s far northeast corner, and Shijaiya, a Gaza City neighborhood founded 800 years ago, are now block after block of leveled houses and apartment towers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli government statements and filings on Gaza genocide allegations
occurrences.quote_span: Israel rejects accusations of genocide, saying it targets Hamas militants and their infrastructure that are interwoven with civilian areas.
occurrences.speaker: Israeli government
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification assessments and Gaza aid-import records
occurrences.quote_span: An increased flow of aid and commercial products brought Gaza back from famine that arose in some areas last year under a monthslong Israeli ban on food and other goods.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Planet Labs satellite imagery of Gaza
occurrences.quote_span: The Planet Labs imagery shows at least 50 Israeli military outposts built throughout the Israeli-held part of Gaza, at least 18 of them constructed since the ceasefire began.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Gaza civil-defense and body-recovery records
occurrences.quote_span: Thousands of bodies remain buried under buildings smashed by Israeli strikes. Since the ceasefire, Gaza authorities have slowly been going from site to site to try to find them.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Satellite imagery and U.N. facility records for Jabaliya
occurrences.quote_span: In Jabaliya in the north, most of the al-Awda Hospital Complex was reduced to rubble in recent months, as were a number of U.N.-run school buildings, satellite images show.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Planet Labs satellite imagery of Rafah
occurrences.quote_span: Most of Rafah was razed before the ceasefire, but images show that troops continue to demolish the few remaining buildings.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Satellite imagery of Bani Suheila
occurrences.quote_span: A new base also stands on what was once the main intersection of the southern town of Bani Suheila. Leveled over the past year, the town is now a wasteland intersected by a spiderweb of dirt paths that were once streets.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Ceasefire agreement implementation records and Israel-Hamas negotiations
occurrences.quote_span: The ceasefire agreement’s plan for the large-scale reconstruction of Gaza has never gotten off the ground because Israel and Hamas have failed to reach a deal on disarming the militant group.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Planet Labs satellite imagery and building-damage assessments
occurrences.quote_span: Satellite imagery by Planet Labs PBC shows that the vast majority of buildings in the Israel-held part have been bulldozed or exploded down to piles of rubble, much of it after major fighting ended a year ago.
occurrences.speaker: Planet Labs PBC
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Gaza casualty records and prewar population estimates
occurrences.quote_span: More than one out of every 10 people from Gaza’s prewar population has been killed or wounded by Israeli fire.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli border-crossing records and Gaza import records
occurrences.quote_span: People no longer have to flee from place to place, but few can rebuild homes because Israel bars most construction material from entering Gaza.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Israeli military

occurrences.checkable_against: Israeli military demolition statements and engineering-operation records
occurrences.quote_span: The Israeli military says it demolishes buildings to prevent their use by Hamas militants or to destroy the group’s tunnel networks.
occurrences.speaker: Israeli military
occurrences.subject: Israeli military
